sign_in_intro: For organizers. Participants don't need an account: use the link from your organizer.
link_sent_body: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
sign_up_intro: Set up events, workshops and sessions. You can invite others later.
add_passkey: Add a passkey for faster sign-in
passkey_added: Passkey added. Next time, sign in with it.
error_invalid_credentials: That email and password don't match. Check them, or sign in with an email link.
error_password_compromised: This password has appeared in a data breach. Choose a different one.
error_password_too_short: Use at least 10 characters for your password.
error_user_exists: There's already an account with this email. Sign in instead.
error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
error_passkey: The passkey didn't work. Try again, or sign in with an email link.
error_generic: That didn't work. Try again in a moment.
events_empty: No events yet. Create your first one: you can add workshops and sessions after that.
mode_booking_body: First come, first served. People pick exact times while places last.
mode_ranking_title: They rank favourites, and you plan it
mode_ranking_body: People rank workshops. You run the planning and publish everyone’s programme.
create_sessions_question: How many sessions does each person attend?
draft_notice: Only your team can see this event until you publish it.
delete_workshop_confirm: Delete {title}? Its sessions are deleted too.
workshops_empty: No workshops yet. Add the first one, and you can plan sessions after that.
sessions_empty: No sessions yet. Pick a workshop and add the times it runs.
schedule_needs_workshops: Add a workshop first, then schedule its sessions.
room_conflict: Same room at the same time as {other}
programme_empty: The programme isn’t ready yet. Check back soon.
not_found_body: Check the link, or ask the person who shared it.
field_date_order: The last day can’t be before the first day.
field_time_order: The end time must be after the start time.
field_outside_event: This date is outside the event’s dates.
field_out_of_range: This number is out of range.
error_forbidden: Your role can’t make this change. Ask an owner or editor.
error_not_found: This no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
content_language_hint: Screen readers use this to pronounce your workshop titles.
window_hint: Leave empty to keep it open until you close it yourself.
rank_minimum_hint: Leave empty to use sessions per person plus one.
show_times_label: Show session times while people rank
show_explanations_label: Show people why they got each session
empty_slots_legend: When someone’s favourites are all full
fill_none: Leave the slot empty and show it to you
fill_any_open: Fill it with any session that still has room
strategy_take_turns_body: Everyone gets one pick per round, and the order reverses each round.
strategy_early_birds_body: People who submitted their ranking earlier choose first in every round.
role_owner_body: Manages the team and can delete the organization.
role_editor_body: Changes events and runs the planning.
invitation_other_email: This invitation was sent to {email}. Sign in with that address to accept it.
invitation_expired: This invitation has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
error_already_member: This person is already on your team.
error_already_invited: This person already has an invitation waiting.
web_address_hint: Old links and QR codes keep working after you change this.
field_taken: This address is already in use. Try another.
field_reserved: This address is reserved. Try another.
age_groups_hint: Optional. Use them to limit workshops to certain ages, like 12–14 or 15–18.
everyone_hint: Leave all unticked if everyone can join.
field_duplicate: You already have an age group with this name.
waitlist_position: You are number {position} on the waitlist.
refusal_full: This session filled up while you were choosing. Pick another time or join the waitlist.
refusal_overlap: This clashes with a session you already booked.
refusal_same_workshop: You already booked this workshop at another time.
refusal_limit: You booked all your sessions. Cancel one to choose another.
refusal_closed: Booking is closed for this event.
refusal_not_eligible: This workshop isn’t for your age group.
refusal_too_late: It’s too late to change this booking. Ask your organizer.
refusal_bot: We couldn’t check that you’re not a bot yet. Wait a moment and try again.
register_intro: We’ll email you a link to your programme. No password needed.
consent_label: The organizer may use my name and email for this event. They’re deleted 90 days after it.
register_existing: Check your email: if you’re already registered, we sent you a new link to your programme.
registered_done: You’re registered. Your link is on its way by email.
code_wrong: That code doesn’t match this event. Check it and try again.
find_programme_sent: If that email is registered here, we sent it a new link. Older links stop working.
my_day_empty: Nothing booked yet. Pick sessions in the programme.
cancel_registration_confirm: Cancel your registration for {event}? Your places go to people on the waitlist.
registration_cancelled: Your registration is cancelled. You can close this page.
participants_empty: No participants yet. Share the event page, or add participants yourself.
new_codes_warning: This makes new codes and links for {count} participants. Cards or links you handed out earlier stop working.
guardians_emailed: Links sent: {sent}. Without a guardian email: {skipped}.
import_hint: A CSV file with the columns name, age group and guardian email. Semicolon exports from Excel work too.
card_hint: Scan or go to the event page and type the code.
field_not_found: This doesn’t exist in this event.
field_too_many: Too many rows: split the file.
error_page_body: Check your connection, then try again.
rank_intro: Pick {min} to {max}. We’ll fit in as many of your top picks as we can.
ranking_saved: Your ranking is saved. You can change it until ranking closes.
ranking_waiting: Your ranking is in. Your programme appears here once the organizer publishes it.
trace_overlap: {workshop} clashed with a session you already had.
trace_filled: You were placed in {workshop} to fill your programme.
trace_exhausted: Nothing else you ranked was still possible.
allocation_booking_mode: This event uses booking. Switch to ranking in Settings to plan with an allocation.
move_overlap: That clashes with another session they have.
move_not_eligible: That workshop isn’t for their age group.
fill_empty_hint: Gives everyone with an empty place a session that still has room, even one they didn’t rank.
publish_confirm_first: This shows {count} participants their programme and emails them.
publish_confirm_again: {count} people’s programmes will change. They’ll get an email.
data_deleted: This event's participant data has been anonymised. Names and contact details are gone; attendance counts remain.
refusal_busy: Too many tries in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
error_reauthenticate: For this, sign in again first (your sign-in is more than 12 hours old).
checkin_read_only: You can follow the counts. Checking people in needs an owner or editor.
checkin_queued: No connection. Scans waiting to be sent: {count}. They go out when the connection is back.
checkin_offline: No connection. The scan is saved on this phone and sent when the connection is back.
scanner_label: Camera view for scanning QR codes
scanner_no_camera: The camera isn't available. Allow camera access for this site, or type the code below.
checkin_unknown: This code isn't for this event, or it no longer works. Try the name search.
exports_hint: Spreadsheet files (CSV). They're kept for 7 days, then deleted.
retention_scheduled: Participant data will be anonymised on {date}. Names, emails and rankings go; attendance counts stay.
retention_confirm: This removes every participant's name, email, guardian email, ranking and link for this event, now. It can't be undone. Attendance counts stay.
audit_intro: Who did what in this organization, including who looked at participant data. Only owners see this.
checkin_queue_refused: Saved scans sent. Not checked in (not booked here or not recognised): {count}. Find them by name.
delete_workshop_body: Its sessions are deleted too. This can't be undone.
passkey_body: Add a passkey and skip the email link next time.
my_day_empty_ranking: Your programme appears here once the organizer runs the planning.
checkin_names_hint: Load the list to find people by name and check them in by hand.
book_intro: Register once, then book up to {count} sessions. Places go first come, first served.
next_rank_body: {ranked} of {total} people have ranked their favourites. When ranking closes, plan the sessions.
next_book_body: {booked} of {places} places are booked. On the day, check people in by QR code or by name.
unpublish_body: Participants can no longer open the page or book. You can publish it again later.
marker_hint: Every workshop gets its own colour and shape. Shapes keep it recognisable in black and white.
checkin_nobody: No one is expected here yet
checkin_nobody_hint: People appear once they book this session or the allocation is published.
allocation_booking_body: In this event people book sessions themselves, so there is nothing to allocate.
